environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'monitoring' with identical code deployed. The Lambda function URL endpoint (https://xyz789.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/) has AuthType=AWS_IAM configured at the resource policy level. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function specifies a Condition block requiring lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType equals AWS_IAM and the principal must match the EKS pod's IRSA role ARN (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/eks-monitoring-orchestrator-role). Unauthenticated callers receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda URL endpoint before any invocation occurs. The pod's Kubernetes ServiceAccount is annotated with eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn pointing to a role that has no lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. Additionally, a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy (cilium.io/v2 CiliumNetworkPolicy) is applied that performs gRPC-aware filtering on port 50051, restricting the 'RunDiagnostic' method to only be callable from pods with label app=lambda-orchestrator-proxy in the same namespace.
